name: Petras Auštrevičius, Roberts Zīle - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on military mobility
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for faster movement of troops and military equipment across Europe. It wants common rules so tanks and convoys are not stopped at borders by paperwork or weak bridges. It asks for much more money to upgrade roads, railways, ports and bridges for military use, and for a "military Schengen" area. It also wants better cooperation with NATO and protection against cyberattacks and sabotage. The report is the Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to propose new rules and more funding.
- **Who it affects:** Soldiers, transport companies, ports, railways and border authorities in EU countries.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is expected to present a military mobility package by the end of 2025.
